subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this combined issue remain open as the coordination item for Control UI reply metadata plus no-output fallback UX, or should maintainers split it so structured Control UI reply metadata is tracked separately from durable final fallback delivery?
rationale: The remaining behavior crosses Control UI UX, Gateway protocol/request shape, runtime prompt context, and durable delivery semantics, so an autonomous fix could choose the wrong permanent boundary.

options.title: Keep Open And Split Scope
options.body: Keep this issue open, narrow it to the Control UI/Gateway structured reply metadata contract, and explicitly route final fallback semantics to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561.

options.title: Close After Choosing Canonicals
options.body: Close this issue only after maintainers choose one canonical reply-metadata item and one canonical no-output delivery item that preserve the unique Control UI context here.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Threading Roadmap
options.body: Treat the reply metadata work as part of broader threaded-entry-point product design, accepting that no single fix PR should target this composite report yet.

recommendation.title: Keep Open And Split Scope
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, narrow it to the Control UI/Gateway structured reply metadata contract, and explicitly route final fallback semantics to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and recent PR metadata put this handle on the active Control UI/runtime split files, which makes them the best available routing point for the cross-surface scoping decision.
